notes.title: Update v1.0.1
notes.content:
We've just uploaded the first update for DRIFT 84.

New Features:
[list]
    [*]Added Portugal Stage
    [*]Added Oval Rock, Dom Casal, Morais Tracks
    [*]After completing 3 stars you will only be able to win 25% of the prize for that track when replaying.
    [*]Steam leaderboards now added - There may be bugs as we are yet to test on a large scale.
[*]Your lap times will automatically be uploaded for each track and your rank shown at the end of the race after the stars are shown.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
    [*]Wrong star count showing in track selecting
    [*]wrong track times finishing at end of race
    [*]incorrect prize fee being shown 
[/list]

notes.title: Want to blog, stream or video review DRIFT 84?
notes.content: We are currently looking for video game journalists, bloggers, youtubers and streamers to give DRIFT 84 a lap around the track. If you would like a pre-alpha key send us an email with some information to info@reventador.co.uk
